# HermesBee

> One-time-purchase web scraping & AI agent tools. Local-first: everything runs on your machine, data never leaves it. No subscriptions, no cloud, no API keys required for most products.

## What HermesBee is

HermesBee sells downloadable developer tools in two forms:
- **MCP servers** for AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf) — give agents real browser, scraping, and data capabilities
- **Desktop apps** — double-click-to-start GUI tools for non-programmers

All products are one-time purchases, run 100% locally, and bypass anti-bot/Cloudflare protection where relevant.

## Core capabilities

- Local REST scraping API (ScrapeBox / ScrapeBox Pro) with Cloudflare bypass
- MCP browser tools: full browser automation with Cloudflare bypass for AI agents
- MCP scraping tools: natural-language web data extraction
- Domain monitoring MCP (WHOIS / expiry / DNS)
- Passive income monitoring MCP
- B2B lead finding (MCP + Desktop, no login required)
- Desktop apps: LitSearch (academic search), PatentSearch / PatentWatch (patent research), StudyPal (citations & Anki), LLM Scraper Desktop

- [Smart Scraper MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/smart-scraper-mcp) — $15 — Basic intelligent scraper: title, content, links, images

- [Income Monitor MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/income-monitor-mcp) — $10 — Track passive income across platforms
- [B2B Lead Finder MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/b2b-lead-finder-mcp) — $29 — Find B2B leads without login (companies, decision-makers, LinkedIn jobs, GitHub devs)
